newsitem.title: USA: ChaseMellon to buy stock transfer business.
newsitem.headline: ChaseMellon to buy stock transfer business.

text.p: ChaseMellon Shareholder Services and NationsBank Corp said they have signed a definitive agreement in which ChaseMellon will purchase the stock transfer business that NationsBank inheritied from Boatmen's Bancshares Inc.
The transaction, which is subject to regulatory approval, is expected to close in the second quarter.
ChaseMellon says it plans to open an office in St. Louis. It said it expects staff at this office to include some of the current employees of the NationsBank stock transfer business in St. Louis.
